name: Pudendal Neuralgia
definition: Neuropathic pelvic/perineal pain attributed to pudendal nerve irritation or entrapment, often worsened by sitting.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical; pelvic MRI and neurophysiologic testing are selective to exclude alternative causes.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Nerve blocks or decompression are reserved for carefully selected cases.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vankshana/Guda Vata-neuralgic phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Neuropathic pelvic/perineal pain attributed to pudendal nerve irritation or entrapment, often worsened by sitting.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, major trauma, suspected infection, pathological fracture, neurovascular compromise or other listed red flags.
